howto.what: 装好后，Claude会作为Uniswap v4钩子开发的安全顾问，帮忙做威胁建模、分析权限标志、预防NoOp攻击、核对Delta账目，并生成部署前审计检查清单。
howto.when: 当你说要开发、审查或审计Uniswap v4的hooks时触发，也适用于询问权限标志、NoOp攻击、Delta核算等安全问题。

say.text: 帮我分析这个hook的权限标志。

Claude会评估攻击风险并给出预防建议。

say.text: 给我一份部署前的审计检查清单。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a security-first assistant for Uniswap v4 hooks, offering threat modeling, permission flag analysis, NoOp attack prevention, delta accounting, and pre-deployment audit checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build, review, or audit Uniswap v4 hooks, or mention permission flags, NoOp attacks, delta accounting, or security concerns.

say_en.text: Analyze the permission flags of this hook.
say_en.note: Checks if the flags are set correctly.

say_en.text: Is my hook vulnerable to NoOp attacks?
Give me a pre-deployment audit checklist.
